personality: 6 Glass / Luxe DARK (adapted with 7 Dark-First Utility high-contrast metrics for exam preparation)
personality_one_liner: A prestigious, authoritative dark-themed exam preparation command center combining dark navy sophistication with professional gold accents for Bengali police officers.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical rhythm with 1.7-1.9 line height for Bengali script clarity and accessible touch targets >= 44x44pt.

do's: Use frosted glass overlays with brand tint on featured cards and headers
Apply translucent surface styling with blur on sticky bottom navigation and headers
dont's: Never apply blur to form inputs or dense text reading areas
Never allow low contrast text over glass surfaces

screens.name: Splash
screens.purpose: Immersive dark navy launch screen with golden police shield emblem and loading indicator.

states.loading: Showing animated golden emblem and welcome text in Bengali

screens.layout: Centered logo, app title in Noto Sans Bengali, subtle pulse animation, automatic transition to Onboarding or Home.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: 3-step interactive intro highlighting police promotion exam modules, timed mock tests, and AI study assistance.
screens.layout: Full-bleed imagery with dark gradient scrim, bottom paginated indicator, and sticky primary action 'শুরু করুন' (Get Started).

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Secure officer credential entry with service ID and PIN / password.

states.error: Invalid Service ID or PIN. Try again.

screens.layout: Single column form with top badge logo, labeled inputs, and sticky primary button.

screens.name: Registration
screens.purpose: New officer profile creation with rank, unit, and service ID.
screens.layout: Scrollable form with rank selector dropdown, service ID, password inputs, and register CTA.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: Central command center with welcome card, daily progress stats, quick actions, subjects, and recommended tests.

states.loading: Skeleton card loaders for daily progress and subjects
states.empty: No recent tests found. Start an MCQ practice session.
states.error: Failed to load dashboard data. Retry.

screens.layout: Scrollable vertical feed with sticky top header, welcome banner, 8 quick action grid, horizontal subject scroll, and vertical recommended tests.

screens.name: Subject List
screens.purpose: Comprehensive catalog of all police promotion subjects (Constitution, Penal Code, Police Act, etc.).
screens.layout: Single column card list with subject title, progress bar, lesson count, and chevron.

screens.name: Subject Details
screens.purpose: Detailed breakdown of a chosen subject with chapters, notes, and topic-wise MCQ practice.
screens.layout: Header banner with subject statistics, accordion chapter list, and bottom sticky practice CTA.

screens.name: MCQ Practice
screens.purpose: Interactive multiple choice question practice engine with instant feedback.

states.empty: No questions available in this set.

screens.layout: Top progress indicator & timer, question card with Bengali text, 4 option buttons with instant color highlight, and bottom navigation controls.

screens.name: MCQ Result
screens.purpose: Immediate post-practice summary showing score, correct/incorrect count, and explanation review.
screens.layout: Circular score gauge, metrics breakdown cards, explanation review list, and action buttons ('পুনরায় চেষ্টা করুন', 'হোমে ফিরুন').

screens.name: Question Bank
screens.purpose: Searchable archive of previous years' questions categorized by law and year.

states.empty: No questions matched your search query.

screens.layout: Top search bar with year/subject filter chips, scrollable question list with tags and bookmark button.

screens.name: Mock Test List
screens.purpose: Full-length timed exam simulations mimicking actual police promotion board tests.
screens.layout: Card list with test duration, total marks, difficulty badge, and 'অংশগ্রহণ করুন' (Take Test) button.

screens.name: Mock Test Instructions
screens.purpose: Exam rules, negative marking details, and time limits before starting simulation.
screens.layout: Checklist of rules, warning banner, confirmation checkbox, and sticky start exam CTA.

screens.name: Mock Test Interface
screens.purpose: Full-screen exam simulation with countdown timer, question palette, and navigation.
screens.layout: Top sticky header with countdown timer and question number, main question card, bottom question palette drawer, and submit button.

screens.name: Mock Test Result
screens.purpose: Comprehensive exam performance scorecard with percentile rank and subject-wise accuracy.
screens.layout: Score badge, rank analysis card, subject accuracy breakdown bars, and review wrong answers CTA.

screens.name: Notes List
screens.purpose: Curated study notes, case laws, and legal commentary for promotion exams.

states.empty: No notes available in this category.

screens.layout: Category filter tabs and card list with note title, reading time, author, and bookmark icon.

screens.name: Note Details
screens.purpose: Immersive legal note reading screen with adjustable font size and bookmarking.
screens.layout: Sticky top bar with font size controls and bookmark toggle, scrollable article view with highlighted legal sections in Noto Sans Bengali.

screens.name: Previous Questions
screens.purpose: Archive of past 10 years promotion board question papers with solved answers.
screens.layout: Year-wise accordion list with PDF download indicator and online view button.

screens.name: AI Question Generator placeholder
screens.purpose: Simulated AI custom test creator allowing officers to generate custom topic quizzes.
screens.layout: Topic selection chips, slider for question count, difficulty selector, and 'এআই প্রশ্ন তৈরি করুন' CTA.

screens.name: AI Study Assistant placeholder
screens.purpose: Interactive legal AI chatbot to answer police regulations and criminal law queries.

states.empty: Ask any legal question (e.g., 'ধারা ৩০২ এর বিধান কী?').
states.error: Failed to connect to AI assistant.

screens.layout: Chat message history feed, suggested prompt chips, and bottom sticky input bar with send button.

screens.name: Bookmarks
screens.purpose: Saved questions and legal notes for quick revision before the exam.

states.empty: No bookmarks saved yet. Tap bookmark icon on any question or note.

screens.layout: Segmented tabs (Questions / Notes) and card list with delete/unsave action.

screens.name: Wrong Answers
screens.purpose: Automated review log of all incorrectly answered MCQs during practice sessions.

states.empty: Great job! No wrong answers recorded.

screens.layout: Card list of wrong answers with user's answer vs correct answer and detailed legal explanation.

screens.name: Progress Analytics
screens.purpose: Detailed performance graphs, subject-wise strengths, weaknesses, and study streak tracker.

states.empty: Complete at least one test to view analytics.

screens.layout: Top streak card, visual progress charts for accuracy over time, weak area breakdown, and study recommendation box.

screens.name: Premium Page
screens.purpose: Showcase of VIP promotion test series, unlimited AI mock exams, and master legal notes.
screens.layout: Hero banner with golden crown badge, feature checklist comparing Free vs VIP, and upgrade CTA.

screens.name: Subscription Page
screens.purpose: Secure checkout and plan selection screen (Monthly, Quarterly, Yearly VIP).
screens.layout: Plan comparison cards, promo code input, payment method selection (bKash, Nagad, Card), and subscribe button.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Officer profile management displaying service rank, current posting, and exam countdown.
screens.layout: Cover banner, avatar with rank insignia, officer details card, stats summary, and menu options.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: App preferences including dark theme toggle, notifications, font size, and Bengali language options.
screens.layout: Grouped list items with toggles for push notifications, audio feedback, font size selector, and logout button.

screens.name: Notifications
screens.purpose: Alert center for exam date announcements, new mock test releases, and study tips.
screens.layout: Chronological list of notification cards with unread indicator badge and timestamp.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure Noto Sans Bengali UI font is loaded and applied across all Bengali text strings. Maintain dark navy (#0F141C) background with professional gold (#D4AF37) accents for police promotion exam preparation. Implement all 27 requested screens with robust loading, empty, and error states. Ensure touch targets >= 44x44pt and support sticky bottom navigation with 5 Bengali tabs (হোম, প্রশ্নপত্র, প্রশ্ন ব্যাংক, নোটস, প্রোফাইল).
